propositions: Rebar implementation skill must require atomic `rebar claim <id>` for starting work and remove direct `rebar transition <id> open in_progress` as a start-work alternative.

Rebar claim command should omit explicit assignee by default, applying configured `ticket.default_assignee` or leaving ticket unassigned if empty, with overrides restricted to email or accountId for Jira-reconciled stores.

Brainstorm skill must distinguish blocked work (agent action complete, waits for claimability) from successful review verdict, stating unsigned INDETERMINATE returns exit status 2 with `coverage.llm_ran` false and defers LLM evaluation.
Both skills must preserve dependency-order guidance and prohibit agent force invocation.

Ticket arid-gutless-myna (which introduced inaccurate successful-cycle wording) requires append-only correction comment via `rebar comment` while status, description, and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
